## Services

### 1. Sober Driver (ფხიზელი მძღოლი / მძღოლი გამოძახებით)
**URL:** https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/sober-driver

A professional, sober driver meets you at your location (restaurant, bar, party, clinic, event) and drives you home safely **in your own car**. Your vehicle stays with you — no need to retrieve it the next day.

- **Starting price:** from 40 GEL within Tbilisi (agreed upfront)
- **Availability:** 24/7, 365 days/year
- **Arrival time:** 15–20 minutes on average
- **Book via:** phone call or WhatsApp to +995 568 83 47 07

**Common use cases:** after drinking alcohol at a restaurant or party, fatigue/exhaustion after a long day, post-medical procedures, car relocation/transfers.

**Q: How do I book a sober driver in Tbilisi?**
A: Call or WhatsApp +995 568 83 47 07. The operator will respond immediately and dispatch the nearest available driver. No advance booking required, though recommended on holidays.

**Q: Does the sober driver use my own car?**
A: Yes. The driver arrives at your location and drives you home in your own vehicle. The driver then returns via a support vehicle.

**Q: How much does a sober driver cost in Tbilisi?**
A: Prices start from 40 GEL within Tbilisi. The exact fare is agreed upfront with the dispatcher based on route and distance.

**Q: Is the sober driver service available at 4 AM or on public holidays?**
A: Yes. mdzgholi.ge operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year — including New Year's Eve, Easter, and all public holidays.

**Q: What if there's an accident while the sober driver is driving my car?**
A: All mdzgholi.ge drivers are vetted professionals. In the unlikely event of an incident, the company takes full responsibility per its protocols.

**Q: How does the car wash pickup service work in Tbilisi?**

### 5. Airport Transfer & Intercity (აეროპორტის ტრანსფერი)
**URL:** https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/airport-transfer

Punctual airport transfers to/from Tbilisi International Airport, Kutaisi, and Batumi airports. Also covers intercity routes across all of Georgia — Batumi, Kutaisi, Kazbegi, and more.

- **Meet & greet:** driver meets you in the arrival hall with a name sign
- **Flight monitoring:** driver adjusts arrival time based on real flight data; waiting for delays is free
- **Vehicles:** sedans (3–4 passengers) and minivans (6–8 passengers)
- **Pricing:** fixed rates, agreed in advance, including parking fees

**Q: How does the airport pickup work with mdzgholi.ge?**
A: The driver meets you in the arrivals hall with a sign displaying your name. Flight tracking ensures the driver is there at your actual landing time — delays don't cost you extra.

**Q: Can mdzgholi.ge do a transfer from Tbilisi to Batumi?**
A: Yes. mdzgholi.ge covers intercity routes across all of Georgia, including Tbilisi–Batumi, Tbilisi–Kutaisi, and Tbilisi–Kazbegi.

**Q: Can I request a child seat for an airport transfer?**
A: Yes. Specify this during booking and a child safety seat will be provided.

### 6. Battery Charging & Jump Start (აკუმულატორის დატენვა და დამუხტვა)
**URL:** https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/battery-charging

On-site car battery jump start and emergency charging service in Tbilisi 24/7. Powered by digital high-output jump starters (boosters) with anti-surge and polarity protection — 100% safe for modern car electronics and ECUs.

- **Primary Keywords (KA):** აკუმულატორის დატენვა, დატენვა, დამჯდარი აკუმულატორის დამუხტვა, დამუხტვა, აკუმულატორის დამუხტვა, აკუმულატორის დაქოქვა, პერემიჩკა გამოძახებით, ბუსტერით დაქოქვა
- **Arrival time:** 15–20 minutes on average across all districts of Tbilisi
- **Services:** booster jump start, on-site battery diagnostics, generator/alternator testing, brand-new battery delivery and installation
- **Vehicle compatibility:** petrol, diesel (all displacements), hybrids (12V auxiliary system), and electric vehicles (12V system)
- **Pricing:** transparent, agreed upfront with dispatch; no hidden fees

**Q: Can mdzgholi.ge charge or jump start a dead car battery on-site in Tbilisi?**
A: Yes. A mobile technician arrives in 15–20 minutes with digital booster packs to safely jump start and charge the battery on the spot.

**Q: Does booster jump starting damage modern vehicle electronics?**
A: No. Unlike amateur jumper cables from another car, mdzgholi.ge uses digital micro-controlled boosters with built-in surge and reverse-polarity protection, keeping vehicle ECUs completely safe.

**Q: What if the battery is completely exhausted and cannot hold charge?**
A: The technician tests battery health and alternator output. If the battery is ruined, mdzgholi.ge can promptly deliver and install a new battery on-site with manufacturer warranty.

**Q: Is the battery charging service available 24/7 at night and during bad weather?**
A: Yes, mdzgholi.ge operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week in Tbilisi and surrounding areas.

### 7. Mobile Tire Change & Roadside Repair (საბურავის შეცვლა)
**URL:** https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/tire-change

Emergency mobile tire change and roadside puncture repair across Tbilisi. No need to tow the car to a stationary vulcanization shop.

- **Arrival time:** 15–20 minutes
- **Services:** flat tire change with spare wheel, on-site puncture repair (vulcanization plug), wheel bolt removal, tire pressure adjustment with portable compressors
- **Vehicle compatibility:** sedans, crossovers, SUVs, and light commercial vehicles

**Q: What if I have a punctured tire but no spare wheel?**
A: Technicians can repair tread punctures directly on the spot using high-durability tire plugs without removing the wheel.

**Q: Is tire change available 24/7 in Tbilisi?**
A: Yes, the mobile tire assistance team is available round the clock 24/7.

- **Availability:** 24/7, every day of the year
